attributes.action: I want the government to listen to the public and ban animal testing now
attributes.additional_details: No animals should be in this day and age of technology used for testing every day products on . The fact that our own government sanctions testing on animals is abhorrent and they need to listen to the general public concerning this . Where is the difference between the average person torturing an animal and these laboratories. Please the public wants this stopped now with no phasing out . We breed 2000 beagles per year to endure hell on earth for our so called benefit and many other species
attributes.background: That we are still testing on animals when we know this doesn't work is beyond cruel . We have better methods of testing which can be used . The government knows this and needs to act now . Any remaining laboratory animals should be handed over to rescue centres where they can be cared for.

rejection.details:
Ban animal testing, require use of alternative testing and invest more in this
